thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Elevated 5xx rate observed on /v1/generate (18% over 5m). Affected region: us-west-2. Paging alice (oncall).
alice (oncall): On it, seeing spike in request errors in realtime dashboard. digging into logs now.
alice (oncall): quick check: error type is `runtime_error: kvcache OOM` on the serving nodes, pattern across 3 pods.
bob (sre): Thanks. Can you dump recent pod logs and memory usage? I'll check autoscaler and node pressure.
alice (oncall): Pasted: ```
2026-03-15T10:12:03Z ERROR runtime_error kvcache OOM at token 1024
2026-03-15T10:12:04Z WARN evicting 128MB cache shard
``` 
alice (oncall): Looks like long-context requests causing KV cache growth and OOM on quantized executors.
dmitri (infra): Node mem at 92% on gpu-pool-3. Autoscaler didn't spin new nodes because CPU-based policy only. Opening quickfix to allow mem-based scale.
frank (eng-lead): If autoscaler won't help fast, can we fallback traffic to smaller context model variant? That should reduce KV requirements.
carla (product): Customer impact? Any paid customers hit or erroring sessions we should notify support about?
emily (support): I already see ~12 support tickets mentioning failures in the last 15m (some on enterprise accounts). Marking customers A-12 and B-7 as possibly impacted.
alice (oncall): Mitigation plan: 1) Patch runtime to reject >2048 token requests for a short window. 2) Route heavy requests to smaller model variant (gptx-8k -> gptx-2k). 3) Expand memory-based autoscale.
bob (sre): Implemented temporary routing rule to send requests with client-specified max_tokens <= 2048 to gptx-8k, else to gptx-2k. Pushed canary, logs show routing active.
incident-bot: Deploy started by bob at 10:24 UTC. 4/4 canary pods healthy.
alice (oncall): After routing change error rate dropped to 2.1% in last 3m. ✅ Keep monitoring for 30m then start handoff.
carla (product): Good. Emily, please send short customer notice to affected enterprise accounts summarizing mitigation and next steps.
emily (support): Drafting now, will send in 10m once we confirm sustained recovery. cc @carla.
frank (eng-lead): Post-incident follow-ups: we need a postmortem, action items on autoscaler policy, KV cache backpressure, and an alert tuning review.
grace (monitoring): Noted. Current alerts that fired: `5xx-rate-high` (threshold 5%) and `node-memory-pressure` (threshold 85%). We should debounce the 5xx alert to avoid noise for short spikes and add a composite condition: 5xx-rate >5% AND sustained >5m.
bob (sre): Agreed. Also add a new alert: `kvcache-oom` when runtime emits OOM stack traces — that can go straight to eng-oncall instead of paging on general 5xx.
alice (oncall): Handoff plan: I'll stay until 11:00 UTC, then hand to bob for overnight. If error rate climbs above 5% escalate immediate page.
alice (oncall): Handoff notes: mitigation routing in place, autoscaler mem-policy PR open (link: https://git.enterprise/repo/pulls/234), support notified draft ready.
bob (sre): Taking over at 11:00 UTC. I'll keep the routing rule for now and monitor memory/autoscale metrics. If we see new OOM pattern we'll revert to full reject policy.
carla (product): Postmortem: schedule 1-hour review tomorrow 14:00 UTC. Owners: frank (technical writeup), grace (alerting follow-up), dmitri (autoscaler change), bob (runtime fix), emily (customer comms). Please add to calendar.
frank (eng-lead): I'll write root-cause + timeline. Proposed RCA buckets: 1) KV cache growth due to long-context requests, 2) Autoscaler not reading GPU mem leading to insufficient capacity, 3) Alert thresholds too sensitive to short spikes.
grace (monitoring): Action items for alerting: - Debounce 5xx alert with 5m window - Add kvcache-oom alert with logs pattern - Move paging for memory-pressure to SRE rather than oncall for noisy nodes
bob (sre): Runtime action items: - Add backpressure to reject huge prefix lengths with clear 429 message - Improve KV cache eviction heuristics - Emit structured OOM events to logs (owner: bob)
dmitri (infra): Autoscaler action items: - Add GPU mem-based scaling trigger + test in staging (owner: dmitri) - Add emergency-burst capacity policy for short spikes (owner: dmitri + infra)
emily (support): Customer comms: - Send update 1 (mitigation complete) - Schedule follow-up with impacted customers after postmortem (owner: emily)
carla (product): Please add action items to the incident tracker with owners and ETA. I'll review on Monday.
alice (oncall): Closing loop: currently 5xx is stable <3% for 25m. Will file post-incident checklist and attach logs to tracker.
incident-bot: Incident resolved at 11:02 UTC. Severity: Sev2. Recording thread and creating postmortem ticket #INC-20260315-42.
alice (oncall): thanks team. small note: consider an automated circuit-breaker in the runtime that enforces per-tenant memory quotas to avoid noisy tenants causing global OOM.
frank (eng-lead): Agree. Add as `design: per-tenant kv quotas` in the action items. I'll own the design with bob.
carla (product): OK. Confirmed postmortem scheduled. Everyone please attach any logs, dashboards, and timeline clips to the ticket. :white_check_mark:
